lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਬਸੰਤ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਹ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n s thaan basa(n)t dha(n)n jah japeeai naam ||
lines.translation: Blessed is that place, and blessed are those who dwell there, where they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਘਨਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kathaa keeratan har at ghanaa sukh sahaj bisraam ||3||
lines.translation: The Sermon and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung there very often; there is peace, poise and tranquility. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: man te kade na veesarai anaath ko naath ||
lines.translation: In my mind, I never forget the Lord; He is the Master of the masterless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਾਥ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee jaa kai sabh kichh haath ||4||29||59||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God; everything is in His hands. ||4||29||59||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਬੰਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin too ba(n)dh kar chhodiaa phun sukh mahi paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The One who bound you in the womb and then released you, placed you in the world of joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸੀਤਲ ਹੋਤਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa simar charanaarabi(n)d seetal hotaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Contemplate His Lotus Feet forever, and you shall be cooled and soothed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਅਥਵਾ ਮੁਇਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevatiaa athavaa muiaa kichh kaam na aavai ||
lines.translation: In life and in death, this Maya is of no use.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ਕੋਊ ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ehu rachan rachaaiaa kooo tis siu ra(n)g laavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He created this creation, but rare are those who enshrine love for Him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੈ ਘਾਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: re praanee usan seet karataa karai ghaam te kaadhai ||
lines.translation: O mortal, the Creator Lord made summer and winter; He saves you from the heat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਰੀ ਤੇ ਹਸਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਟੂਟਾ ਲੇ ਗਾਢੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: keeree te hasatee karai tootaa le gaadhai ||2||
lines.translation: From the ant, He makes an elephant; He reunites those who have been separated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਕਿਰਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)daj jeraj setaj utabhujaa prabh kee ih kirat ||
lines.translation: Eggs, wombs, sweat and earth - these are God's workshops of creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸਰਬ ਫਲ ਰਵੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kirat kamaavan sarab phal raveeai har nirat ||3||
lines.translation: It is fruitful for all to practice contemplation of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵਨਾ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham te kachhoo na hovanaa saran prabh saadh ||
lines.translation: I cannot do anything; O God, I seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਕੂਪ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਢ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: moh magan koop a(n)dh te naanak gur kaadh ||4||30||60||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak pulled me up, out of the deep, dark pit, the intoxication of attachment. ||4||30||60||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਫਿਰਾ ਖੋਜਉ ਬਨ ਥਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat mai phiraa khojau ban thaan ||
lines.translation: Searching, searching, I wander around searching, in the woods and other places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਦ ਅਭੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਐਸੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: achhal achhed abhed prabh aise bhagavaan ||1||
lines.translation: He is undeceivable, imperishable, inscrutable; such is my Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬ ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਆਤਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kab dekhau prabh aapanaa aatam kai ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: When shall I behold my God, and delight my soul?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਨ ਤੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਬਸੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaagan te supanaa bhalaa baseeai prabh sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Even better than being awake, is the dream in which I dwell with God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਨਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: baran aasram saasatr sunau darasan kee piaas ||
lines.translation: Listening to the Shaastras teaching about the four social classes and the four stages of life, I grow thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: roop na rekh na pa(n)ch tat thaakur abinaas ||2||
lines.translation: He has no form or outline, and He is not made of the five elements; our Lord and Master is imperishable. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਹਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu saroop sa(n)tan kahahi virale jogeesur ||
lines.translation: How rare are those Saints and great Yogis, who describe the beautiful form of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਤੇ ਈਸੁਰ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa jaa kau mile dhan dhan te eesur ||3||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed are they, whom the Lord meets in His Mercy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੋ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤਹ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so a(n)tar so baahare binase tah bharamaa ||
lines.translation: They know that He is deep within, and outside as well; their doubts are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥੪॥੩੧॥੬੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tis prabh bhetiaa jaa ke pooran karamaa ||4||31||61||
lines.translation: O Nanak, God meets those, whose karma is perfect. ||4||31||61||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t suprasa(n)n bhae dekh prabh parataap ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures are totally pleased, gazing on God's glorious radiance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਜੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਿ ਆਹਰੁ ਆਪ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: karaj utaariaa satiguroo kar aahar aap ||1||
lines.translation: The True Guru has paid off my debt; He Himself did it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੂਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaat kharachat nibahat rahai gurasabad akhoot ||
lines.translation: Eating and expending it, it is always available; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is inexhaustible.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਸਮਗਰੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran bhaee samagaree kabahoo nahee toot ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Everything is perfectly arranged; it is never exhausted. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਆਰਾਧਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਆਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g aaraadhanaa har nidh aapaar ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I worship and adore the Lord, the infinite treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਦੇਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dharam arath ar kaam mokh dete nahee baar ||2||
lines.translation: He does not hesitate to bless me with Dharmic faith, wealth, fulfilment of desires and liberation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat araadhahi ek ra(n)g gobi(n)d gupaal ||
lines.translation: The devotees worship and adore the Lord of the Universe with single-minded love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam dhan sa(n)chiaa jaa kaa nahee sumaar ||3||
lines.translation: They gather in the wealth of the Lord's Name, which cannot be estimated. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran pare prabh tereeaa prabh kee vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: O God, I seek Your Sanctuary, the glorious greatness of God. Nanak:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੬੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak a(n)t na paaeeai bea(n)t gusaaee ||4||32||62||
lines.translation: Your end or limitation cannot be found, O Infinite World-Lord. ||4||32||62||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਾਰਜ ਭਏ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar pooran prabhoo kaaraj bhae raas ||
lines.translation: Meditate, meditate in remembrance of the Perfect Lord God, and your affairs shall be perfectly resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਪੁਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਵਸੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karataar pur karataa vasai sa(n)tan kai paas ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In Kartaarpur, the City of the Creator Lord, the Saints dwell with the Creator. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bighan na kooo laagataa gur pahi aradaas ||
lines.translation: No obstacles will block your way, when you offer your prayers to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: rakhavaalaa gobi(n)d raai bhagatan kee raas ||1||
lines.translation: The Sovereign Lord of the Universe is the Saving Grace, the Protector of the capital of His devotees. ||1||
